Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival at the Pearland, Texas scene, I fonud two vehicles stopped in the travel lanes after a
sideswipe collision. Driver 1 stated they were changing lanes when the side of their vehicle made contact with the
vehicle operated by Driver 2, who was traveling alongside in the adjacent lane. Driver 2 gave a consistent account,
and two independent witnesses on the roadside described the same sequence of events. I photographed both
vehicles. The damage is concentrated along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and the left front fender
of Driver 2's vehicle, which is consistent with the lateral impact described. I found no prior damage to either vehicle at
the scene. Passenger was seated in the front right position of Driver 1's vehicle and was confirmed by both drivers
and the witnesses. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was evaluated by EMS on scene. The reported knee
injury is plausible given the mechanism of this collision. Driver 1 advised that they live in the same household as the
policyholder of the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene.
